steps.title: Define 3D Visual Requirements
steps.description: Plan out premium skeuomorphic mechanical button layers and inset 3D display panel designs.

steps.title: Update App Metadata
steps.description: Keep metadata for com.moderncalculator.app and app name Modern Calculator.

steps.title: Create Inset Screen Background
steps.description: Design a multi-layered drawable with deep recess gradient for a 3D LCD display plate look.

steps.title: Redesign Tactile 3D Number Buttons
steps.description: Implement mechanical 3D button selector with top hover faces and bottom shadows for tactile depth.

steps.title: Redesign Tactile 3D Operator Buttons
steps.description: Configure vivid orange 3D mechanical selector backgrounds using premium multi-level gradients.

steps.title: Redesign Tactile 3D Action Buttons
steps.description: Configure functional slate gray 3D mechanical button selector with high gloss face edges.

steps.title: Revamp Calculator Layout Structure
steps.description: Update activity_main.xml to use the recessed 3D display background, configure padding, and optimize alignment.

steps.title: Integrate Dynamic Tactile Touch Animations
steps.description: Add custom spring scaling click animation feedback inside MainActivity.java to emphasize tactile 3D movement.

steps.title: Verify 3D Visual Flow and Synthesizer Sound
steps.description: Ensure startup synth audio sweeps, operational equations, and reset sequences mesh beautifully with 3D button pushes.

steps.title: Validate Compatibility and Manifest Settings
steps.description: Double check resource namespaces, launcher setups, and compile criteria are correctly verified.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Compile, bundle, and package the tactile 3D application for deployment.
